data.name: Emulation.Nec.Help.Memory.Ram.Short
data.value: Amount of RAM available to the emulated machine.

data.name: Emulation.Nec.Help.Memory.Ram.Detailed
data.value: Selects the RAM expansion exposed by BeetlePce. The machine must restart before the new amount is used.

data.name: Emulation.Nec.Help.Firmware.Integrated.Short
data.value: No external BIOS file is needed for this model.

data.name: Emulation.Nec.Help.Firmware.Integrated.Detailed
data.value: Cartridge games on this machine run without an external system BIOS.

data.name: Emulation.Nec.Help.Video.Resolution.Short
data.value: Internal resolution rendered by BeetlePce.

data.name: Emulation.Nec.Help.Video.Resolution.Detailed
data.value: Selects one of the internal resolutions exposed by BeetlePce. This does not set the application window size.

data.name: Emulation.Nec.Help.Video.Monitor.Short
data.value: Type of monitor emulated by BeetlePce.

data.name: Emulation.Nec.Help.Video.Monitor.Detailed
data.value: Selects a colour, green monochrome, or white monochrome NEC monitor.

data.name: Emulation.Nec.Help.Video.Intensity.Short
data.value: Brightness of the emulated monitor.

data.name: Emulation.Nec.Help.Video.Intensity.Detailed
data.value: Adjusts the monitor intensity from 5 to 15, as exposed by BeetlePce.

data.name: Emulation.Nec.Help.Video.Crop.Short
data.value: Removes the external screen border.

data.name: Emulation.Nec.Help.Video.Crop.Detailed
data.value: Asks BeetlePce to crop the external border. GW GUI keeps the aspect ratio reported by the emulator.

data.name: Emulation.Nec.Help.Audio.FloppySound.Short
data.value: Mechanical sound of the floppy drive.

data.name: Emulation.Nec.Help.Audio.FloppySound.Detailed
data.value: Enables or disables the floppy drive sound generated by BeetlePce.

data.name: Emulation.Nec.Help.General.Model.Short
data.value: Nec machine model being configured.

data.name: Emulation.Nec.Help.General.Emulator.Short
data.value: Emulator selected for this machine.

data.name: Emulation.Nec.Help.General.Emulator.Detailed
data.value: Identifies the emulator implementation used to run this machine configuration.

data.name: Emulation.Nec.Help.Cpu.Model.Short
data.value: Processor emulated for this machine.

data.name: Emulation.Nec.Help.Cpu.Model.Detailed
data.value: Shows the processor model provided by the selected Nec machine.

data.name: Emulation.Nec.Help.Cpu.Frequency.Short
data.value: Original processor clock frequency.

data.name: Emulation.Nec.Help.Cpu.Frequency.Detailed
data.value: Shows the nominal clock frequency of the processor in the selected Nec machine.

data.name: Emulation.Nec.Help.Audio.Enabled.Short
data.value: Enable or disable emulated sound.

data.name: Emulation.Nec.Help.Audio.Enabled.Detailed
data.value: Controls whether GW GUI plays the audio samples generated by the emulator.

data.name: Emulation.Nec.Help.Audio.Output.Short
data.value: Audio output used by GW GUI.

data.name: Emulation.Nec.Help.Audio.Output.Detailed
data.value: Selects the Windows audio output used to play sound from this emulated machine.

data.name: Emulation.Nec.Help.General.Model.Detailed
data.value: Identifies the NEC model whose hardware configuration is being edited.

data.name: Emulation.Nec.Help.Memory.Fixed.Short
data.value: Installed main RAM of this machine.

data.name: Emulation.Nec.Help.Memory.Fixed.Detailed
data.value: This emulator does not provide a main RAM expansion option for this model.

data.name: Emulation.Nec.Help.Firmware.Path.Short
data.value: System BIOS file for CD games.

data.name: Emulation.Nec.Help.Firmware.Path.Detailed
data.value: Choose a Super CD-ROM2 System Card 3 image for PC Engine CD games, or a PC-FX BIOS image for PC-FX. PC-FX requires its BIOS. The selected file is copied into the emulator's system directory when the machine starts.

data.name: Emulation.Nec.Help.Video.Palette.Short
data.value: Color palette of the PC Engine video output.

data.name: Emulation.Nec.Help.Video.HorizontalWidth.Short
data.value: Visible horizontal width for 352-pixel PC Engine modes.

data.name: Emulation.Nec.Help.Video.DotClockWidth.Short
data.value: Rendered width of the PC-FX high dot clock mode.

data.name: Emulation.Nec.Help.Video.ChromaInterpolation.Short
data.value: Interpolates PC-FX chroma for smoother color transitions.

data.name: Emulation.Nec.Help.Video.NoSpriteLimit.Short
data.value: Removes the emulated hardware sprite limit.

data.name: Emulation.Nec.Help.Video.InitialScanline.Short
data.value: First scanline shown by the emulator.

data.name: Emulation.Nec.Help.Video.LastScanline.Short
data.value: Last scanline shown by the emulator.

data.name: Emulation.Nec.Help.Video.FrameSkip.Short
data.value: Controls whether the PC Engine emulator skips frames.

data.name: Emulation.Nec.Help.Video.FrameSkipThreshold.Short
data.value: Audio buffer threshold used by manual frame skip.

data.name: Emulation.Nec.Help.Audio.AdpcmVolume.Short
data.value: Volume of CD ADPCM audio played by Beetle PCE FAST.

data.name: Emulation.Nec.Help.Audio.CdPsgVolume.Short
data.value: Volume of CD PSG audio played by Beetle PCE FAST.

data.name: Emulation.Nec.Help.Audio.AdpcmLowPass.Short
data.value: Filters high frequencies from CD ADPCM audio.

data.name: Emulation.Nec.Help.Audio.SuppressClicks.Short
data.value: Suppresses PC-FX audio clicks caused by channel resets.

data.name: Emulation.Nec.Help.Audio.BuggyCodec.Short
data.value: Emulates the faulty ADPCM encoding used by some PC-FX games.

data.name: Emulation.Nec.Help.Audio.CdVolume.Short
data.value: CD audio volume in PC Engine Duo games.

data.name: Emulation.Nec.Help.Audio.SoundQuality.Short
data.value: PC-FX sound resampling quality.

data.name: Emulation.Nec.Help.Mouse.Sensitivity.Short
data.value: Mouse movement sensitivity for the selected emulator.
